title: Quest. 66. If a man be injuriously suspended or Excommunicated by the Pastor or people, which way shall he have remedy?

segments.text: Answ. AS is aforesaid in case of male-administration; 1. By admonishing the Pastor or those that wrong him. 2. By consulting Neighbour Pastors, that they may admonish him; 3. By the help of Rulers, where such are, and the Churches good forbids it not. 4. In case of extremity by removing to a Church that will not so injure you. And what needs there any more, save patience?
